interface.signature: def ReFormatString(S: str, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S is either alphanumeric or a dash.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c == '-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All alphabetic characters in the output are uppercase, and dashes are preserved only as group separators.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(S) and all(c in return_value for c in S if c.isalnum())
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly the same alphanumeric characters as S (case-insensitive), with no additional or missing characters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in return_value.split('-') if group != return_value.split('-')[0])
postconditions.description: Every group after the first in the output has exactly K characters.
The first group in the output has at least 1 and at most K characters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) <= K for group in return_value.split('-'))
postconditions.description: No group in the output exceeds K characters in length.

postconditions.expression: return_value.count('-') == len([g for g in return_value.split('-') if g != return_value.split('-')[0]]) - 1
postconditions.description: Dashes in the output are inserted only between groups, with no leading or trailing dashes.
